list.emptyBody: When you report a problem with a machine, you can follow it here.

wizard.unregisteredHint: Write what you know: brand, model, color or where it is.
wizard.evidenceHint: Take at least one photo or video of the problem. Up to {max} videos.
wizard.videoCount: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} of {max}
wizard.mediaCount: {count, plural, =0 {No photos or videos} one {# photo or video} other {# photos or videos}}
wizard.locationFailed: Could not get the location. The report can still be sent.
wizard.openExisting: Add info to the existing one
wizard.sent: Report saved. It will be sent when there is signal.
wizard.dragPin: Drag the pin if the problem is somewhere else.
wizard.locationAdjusted: You moved the pin. This place will be sent.

field.title: Short title (optional)
field.descriptionPlaceholder: What you saw, heard or smelled

attention.IN_REPAIR: This machine is already in repair.
attention.OUT_OF_SERVICE: This machine is out of service.

detail.noEvidence: No photos or videos on this device yet.
detail.withdrawBody: The office will see that you withdrew it. Tell us why.
detail.withdrawReasonPlaceholder: Example: I reported the wrong machine
detail.notFoundBody: It may still be downloading. Pull to sync or go back to My reports.
detail.lockedBody: The office already started on this report, so it can no longer be changed. Write a comment below instead.

widget.quickReportBody: Photos, audio and location in a few taps
widget.myReportsOpen: {count, plural, =0 {No open reports} one {# open report} other {# open reports}}
